# Opensource UI

> Free, MIT-licensed copy-paste React and Next.js UI components with live previews and source code.

Opensource UI (https://opensourceui.in) is an open-source component library for React and Next.js. Components are copy-pasted into your project — no npm package install required. Built with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS v4.

## Primary pages

- Homepage: https://opensourceui.in
- Browse all components: https://opensourceui.in/components
- GitHub: https://github.com/bidyut10/opensourceui
- License: MIT — free for personal and commercial use

## Component pages

Each component has a dedicated page with:
- Live preview
- Setup guide
- Copy-ready TypeScript source code

URL pattern: https://opensourceui.in/components/{slug}

Examples:
- https://opensourceui.in/components/slide-to-confirm-button
- https://opensourceui.in/components/analog-clock-widget
- https://opensourceui.in/components/annotated-text

## Categories

Browse by category: https://opensourceui.in/components?category={CategoryName}

Categories include Buttons, Clocks, Mockups, Activity widgets, Calendars, Cards, and more.

## Search

Search components: https://opensourceui.in/components?q={query}

## Stack

- React
- Next.js
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS v4
- Lucide icons
